pages.title: The Store Starts Moving
pages.text: Install a hopper upgrade and, while keeping that container’s menu open, let it transfer at least one item.

pages.title: The Store Starts Moving
pages.text: Try an actual transfer between upgraded storage and a neighboring inventory.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Set the transfer direction, supply an item and keep the upgraded container’s menu open until the transfer commits. Credit goes to the player observing through that exact menu.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Hopper moves items to adjacent blocks; advanced adds input/output side and speed settings rather than world-wide access.
